Quran Mustafa Hain To Yaseen Fatima Sibtain Haider.
Rab Ke Liye Hain Laiq-e-Tahseen Fatima.

1
Jo Aap Ka Nahi Hai Woh Tauheed Ka Nahi.
Rab Ne Bana Liya Hai Yeh Ain Fatima.
Khaliq Ne Unn Ko Markaz-e-Lanat Bana Diya.
Karne Jo Aaye They Teri Tauheen Fatima.

2
Maula Ali Hoye Keh Hussain-o-Hasan Hoye.
Lazim Hain Deen Ke Liye Yeh Teen Fatima.
Karta Hai Wird Sorah-e-Kausar Ka Subha-o-Sham.
 Mehdi Hai Teri Madah Ka Shauqeen Fatima.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/quran-mustafa-hain-to-yaseen-fatima-sibtain-haider-tajpoints-fe21ce29a21affc3b79a.md')
_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---')
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
def blocks(s):
    return [b.splitlines() for b in s.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert [len(b) for b in blocks(roman)] == [len(b) for b in blocks(body)] == [2,5,5]
assert [b[0].strip() for b in blocks(roman)[1:]] == ['1','2']
assert [b[0] for b in blocks(body)[1:]] == ['۱','۲']
assert all(not l or l.startswith('  ') for l in roman.splitlines())
assert '\\u200c' not in body and 'noUrdu' not in front
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 10 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have a two-verse opening and two four-verse stanzas.

Updated the Urdu and Roman titles, set the direction to right-to-left, and removed the `noUrdu` tag. I read “Ain” as عین and “Madah” as مدح. Only the selected Markdown file was edited.
